summary: Keeps every shown layer's raster current: one job per changed layer at the current tier, the edited layer first, shared by every V wearing the preset.
creates: a keyed family of raster nodes, one per raster key

faults.when: A layer's fine glitter lies outside the eye region; its readiness is blocked with a plain reason.
The raster worker crashed; readiness shows updating while it is recreated.

lifetime: Per preset revision and tier, while any visible view or flat editor shows the preset.

x-friction.gap: Today's raster slots are indices into the live recipe and are remapped by hand after a reorder.
x-friction.closes: Change reports per map key, so rasters are keyed by layer ID.
